title: Complex non-sterile compounding pharmacy licensure
rule_summary: Massachusetts separately licenses complex non-sterile compounding pharmacies. Complex non-sterile compounding involves preparation that, consistent with the statutory definition and current standards, requires specialized training, environment, facilities, equipment, or techniques presenting elevated complexity or risk. A satisfactory Board inspection is required before issuance of an original complex non-sterile compounding pharmacy license.
exam_relevance: Distinguishes complex non-sterile compounding from ordinary non-sterile preparation and from sterile compounding.
common_confusions: Non-sterile does not automatically mean simple or exempt from the complex non-sterile licensure category.
verification_notes: Current official Massachusetts authority verified during Pre-Batch3 T2 authoring on 2026-08-18; fresh independent legal and realism audit is still required before release.
